title: Add Shared Ingredient Lists with Real-Time Synchronization
description: Implement ingredient list management with real-time synchronization using SignalR. Users can create ingredient lists (with or without associated recipes), add multiple recipes to lists (N:N relationship), add ingredients with checkboxes, and share lists via email invitation or shareable links. Checkbox state is synchronized in real-time across all users viewing the same list.

Ingredient entity created with Id, IngredientListId, Name, Quantity, Unit, IsChecked, CreatedAt properties

ListSharing entity created with Id, IngredientListId, SharedWithUserId, ShareType (Email|Link), AccessLevel, CreatedAt properties
ListShareToken entity created with Id, IngredientListId, Token, ExpiresAt, CreatedAt for shareable links
All entities have proper indexes on foreign keys and frequently queried fields

PostgreSQL database updated with new tables

tasks.title: Implement API endpoints for ingredient list CRUD operations
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/ingredient-lists - Create new ingredient list (authenticated, sets OwnerId to current user)
GET /api/ingredient-lists - List all ingredient lists current user owns or has access to
GET /api/ingredient-lists/{id} - Get single ingredient list with all ingredients and associated recipes
PUT /api/ingredient-lists/{id} - Update ingredient list name/description (owner only)
DELETE /api/ingredient-lists/{id} - Delete ingredient list (owner only)
POST /api/ingredient-lists/{id}/ingredients - Add ingredient to list
PUT /api/ingredient-lists/{id}/ingredients/{ingredientId} - Update ingredient (name, quantity, unit, isChecked)
DELETE /api/ingredient-lists/{id}/ingredients/{ingredientId} - Delete ingredient from list
POST /api/ingredient-lists/{id}/recipes - Add recipe to ingredient list
DELETE /api/ingredient-lists/{id}/recipes/{recipeId} - Remove recipe from ingredient list
All endpoints have OpenAPI documentation with .WithName() and .WithOpenApi()
Proper authorization checks (only owner or shared user can access)
Input validation with meaningful error messages
Integration tests verify all CRUD operations

tasks.title: Implement ingredient list sharing (email invitation and shareable links)
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/ingredient-lists/{id}/share/email - Send email invitation to share list
Email invitation includes link with token to accept sharing
POST /api/ingredient-lists/{id}/share/link - Generate shareable link token
GET /api/ingredient-lists/shared/{token} - Allow guest access to list via shareable link (read-only or edit based on AccessLevel)
GET /api/ingredient-lists/{id}/sharing - List all active shares for ingredient list (owner only)
DELETE /api/ingredient-lists/{id}/sharing/{shareId} - Revoke access for a shared user (owner only)
Sharing includes access level: Viewer (read-only) or Editor (can modify ingredients/checkboxes)
Email service integration to send invitation emails
ListShareToken validates expiration and prevents expired link access
Integration tests verify sharing workflows

GetListsAsync() returns IngredientList[] (owned and shared lists)
GetListAsync(id) returns IngredientList with ingredients and recipes
CreateListAsync(IngredientListRequest) creates new list
UpdateListAsync(id, IngredientListRequest) updates list
DeleteListAsync(id) deletes list
AddIngredientAsync(listId, IngredientRequest) adds ingredient to list
UpdateIngredientAsync(listId, ingredientId, IngredientRequest) updates ingredient
DeleteIngredientAsync(listId, ingredientId) removes ingredient
AddRecipeToListAsync(listId, recipeId) associates recipe with list
RemoveRecipeFromListAsync(listId, recipeId) removes recipe from list
ShareListViaEmailAsync(listId, email, accessLevel) invites user
GenerateShareLinkAsync(listId, accessLevel) generates shareable link
GetSharedAccessAsync(token) gets list via share token
All methods support CancellationToken
Registered in Web/Program.cs with AddHttpClient and service discovery
